categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in digital surveillance systems and related products, including network cameras, surveillance system hosts, video management software, access control systems, and license plate recognition systems. It also offers AI and cloud-based security solutions, IoT integration, and digital signage products. The business covers software development, hardware manufacturing, and international trade related to security and surveillance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include AI-driven video analytics, cloud surveillance (VSaaS), edge AI computing, and IoT integration for smart security applications. The company develops proprietary software for video management, AI image analysis, access control, and cloud services. Hardware production involves network cameras with various form factors, PoE network switches, and embedded Linux-based systems. Manufacturing includes SMT/DIP processes, assembly, quality control, and packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are enterprises, government agencies, and commercial facilities requiring high-definition video surveillance and security solutions. End markets include smart cities, smart factories, retail, transportation, healthcare, residential complexes, and public infrastructure. The company serves global markets with a focus on North America, Europe, and Asia, targeting system integrators, security solution providers, and end users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with subsidiaries and offices in the United States, Europe (Czech Republic), Japan, China (Shanghai), Vietnam, Canada, and Samoa. Major sales regions include the Americas (67% of sales), Europe (16%), and Asia (11%). It maintains a global distribution and technical support network to serve diverse international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream of the security surveillance supply chain, focusing on product development, manufacturing, and system integration. It sources components such as optical elements, ICs, and PCBs from upstream suppliers and sells finished products through downstream channels including distributors, system integrators, and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI and cloud security technologies, enhancing product innovation in video analytics, facial recognition, and license plate recognition. The company emphasizes ESG responsibilities, including carbon footprint reduction and sustainable packaging. R&D efforts focus on software and hardware integration, edge computing, and expanding cloud-based subscription services (VSaaS). It also aims to strengthen global market expansion and partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of hardware (network cameras, controllers, PoE switches) and proprietary software licenses. The company is developing subscription-based cloud surveillance services (VSaaS) to diversify revenue streams. Additional income comes from after-sales services, technical support, and international trade operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global security firms such as Axis, Hanwha, Bosch, and other European, North American, and Japanese manufacturers. It holds a competitive position as a Taiwanese brand with 100% in-house software development, enabling product differentiation. The company ranks 39th globally in security surveillance revenue and 16th in video surveillance products, leveraging AI and cloud capabilities to compete against traditional and emerging players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.197 billion, a 5.2% decrease from the previous year, with a gross margin of 48%. Net profit attributable to the parent company was NT$625 million, representing a 117.7% increase year-over-year and a net margin of 53%. The company maintains a strong return on equity of 29% and invests about 11% of revenue in R&D. It has a workforce of 158 employees, with 96 in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its fully proprietary software development capability, integrating AI-driven video analytics, cloud surveillance, and IoT solutions to provide comprehensive, intelligent security systems. Its products support multi-language and global market needs, offering high flexibility, security compliance (e.g., NDAA), and advanced features like facial recognition and behavior analysis. The focus on ESG and sustainable practices further differentiates its brand in the global security market.
